defects.description: N+1 sequential external calls: one pricing-API call per order, awaited in a loop, with no batching and no caching -- latency scales linearly with order count.
Unbounded retry with no backoff and no max-attempts on fetchLivePrice -- any pricing-API error becomes an infinite retry loop for that request.
No timeout configured on the pricing API client, so a single slow/hanging upstream call blocks the whole request indefinitely, compounding the retry issue into a full request hang.
